item.title: On Maintenance and Restoration
item.description: I am writing from the library of a chateau in Normandy. It was built, I think the count told me, sometime during the 14th century. The chapel behind the house predates America’s founding by some half-century. On the third floor, there is a hidden room where mass was said secretly during the years of revolution. item.title: The Guidelines They Wanted
item.description: Since 1980, the federal government has been in a constant process of formulating and releasing new dietary guidance to the American public. In that same span of time, the obesity rate has risen from 15% to over 40%. You might assume this is mere correlation, that the guidelines are widely ignored and therefore harmless.
